entities.name: Query NDK protein
observations: 136 aa protein sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Mycobacterium leprae nucleoside diphosphate kinase references B8ZRN7 and Q9CBZ0.
Sequence contains the NDK Pfam domain PF00334.25 spanning residues 3–134.
Reviewed reference annotation identifies active-site His117 as the phosphohistidine intermediate.
Predicted molecular weight is 14,675.6 Da and theoretical pI is 5.19.

entities.name: Nucleoside diphosphate kinase
observations: EC 2.7.4.6 phosphotransferase that transfers the gamma phosphate of ATP to a nucleoside diphosphate through a ping-pong mechanism involving a phosphorylated active-site histidine.
Reviewed annotations support Mg2+ as cofactor, cytoplasmic localization, and homotetrameric assembly for the exact Mycobacterium leprae references.
Catalyzes both ribonucleoside diphosphate and 2'-deoxyribonucleoside diphosphate phosphorylation reactions.

entities.name: NDP + ATP → NTP + ADP
observations: Rhea RHEA:18113 represents ribonucleoside 5'-diphosphate + ATP → ribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate + ADP.
